package.scope: Lightweight added-line review, not a bandit or pip-audit substitute.

budget.scope: One original unchanged install/viewer run; other categories not run.

loading.scope: ABBA with fresh Chrome profile per arm, first browser-cache-cold navigation then actual reload. Local model/OS disk caches warm; server already compiled and physics paused. Ready means scene rendered, no busy/loading plus2RAF and gl.finish, not human input latency or fresh remote model download. RSS is one Chrome process-tree snapshot, not VRAM or peak.

visual_review.method: Viewed four complete fixed before/after comparison contacts and all eight decoded movie contacts in image tool;16fixed DPR2 ordinary/detail panels and48decoded movie samples. Full movies strictly decoded independently, not visually watched frame by frame.
visual_review.finding: Actual added generated aluminium and lab arms retain spatial relief and original colours, with a modest authored reflection-response change. Ordinary-distance difference is subtle; independent explicit-map GPU reference establishes fidelity. No established broad furniture paint improvement or claim that brighter universally looks better. Original Malo/Panda robots, furniture and floor are retained as context; imported raw models are not the gain claim.
visual_review.acceptance: Accept scoped author-environment fidelity fix with measured shader variants and costs; broad goal remains active.
visual_review.limits: Paused scripted camera arc, one declared detail cut. Same planned trajectory is not frame-by-frame synchronization; six movie samples per clip do not establish temporal or action success.

source_bridge: Both before/candidate screen/movie/loading cohorts use final ebfe server/Python source. Before serves exact b901 frozen static tree and candidate serves exact final static tree; Python finite-env validation does not alter valid definitions. Served look.js hashes checked.
mechanism: Vendored Three r178 implicit scene maps override material.envMapIntensity; local composed IBL uniform restores scene intensity times authored multiplier. Default env1 has no added hook, explicit maps keep Three semantics. Covers environment diffuse/specular/clearcoat, not only specular.
initial_paint_diagnostic: 60 retained stills,12 groups; roughness.35 changes pixels but attempted env0 was overridden and has no effective intervention. No valid environment ablation or two-family roughness improvement established; no .45 paint candidate or roughness-default change. Initial shelf selector failure and corrected inventory retained.
limitations: Authoring-time nondefault environment multiplier; default1 materials later mutated directly do not acquire the implicit-map hook. Rebuild after author definition changes.
Independent explicit-map GPU reference has <=1byte maximum rounding tolerance; actual original-world canvas hashes are exact at fixed cameras.
Actual positive images/movies are expressly derived Malo/Panda workspaces with added existing generated robots; imported raw model gains are not claimed.
Different multipliers preserve intended response; brighter is not universal aesthetic improvement. No furniture coating, wood, AO or sky redesign.

Scripted paused camera arcs and one declared detail cut, not native user actions or time-aligned footage; no frame truncation or action-success certification. Eight full decodes and48root samples are not every-frame dynamic inspection.
No new texture, request, geometry, pass or dependency. Shader uniform/variants still carry measured costs; no universal speed or memory-saving claim.
ABBA with2samples per cohort/kind: browser-cache-cold and real reload, warm local model/OS cache, compiled server. RSS snapshots are not peak or VRAM.
